ns2:course.label: Entrepreneurship in Business
ns2:course.description: Covers key elements of starting a business or launching a product including ideation, legal formation, funding, positioning, targeting and marketing. Students can apply these principles and skills to develop and launch new initiatives or become more entrepreneurial in their job. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Restricted to MS: SBC Students.
